lessons.claim: The timescale that sets dt may not be what is being observed, and then the cost is decided independently of the observation band. In chain-bend the fastest bending mode of the stiffness matrix's largest eigenvalue (τ_fast=0.279µs) sets dt while what is being measured is τ_chain=1.27ms, 4570x away → 2.65e9 steps at the lowest ω. The cause is κ_θ=1.39e6 kT (the chain is thermally completely stiff). In 1-A, 1-B and trap-drag the scale that set dt was always near the scale of interest.
